summary: Seeded painters of 2D surfaces on the GPU or the CPU: tileable paper grain and rib knit, and soft painted grounds in a palette, each an albedo and a relief (normal and height) at any size, returned as { digest, buffers } so a host caches them by recipe; and prints, a host's own 2D drawing as a lit texture with roughness and metalness.

inputs.label: Surface
inputs.help: Which of the module's recipes to paint.

inputs.label: Seed
inputs.help: Decides every fibre, stitch and stroke inside the recipe's bounds.

inputs.label: Size
inputs.help: Pixels across; a tile is square.
